title: Mystic Witch Laboratory
description: A female witch in a dark green dress stands behind a cluttered wooden workbench in a mystical attic laboratory, mixing glowing potions. The room features floating magical orbs on pedestals, shelves filled with colorful bottles, arcane paintings on stone walls, a glowing lantern, and glowing footprints leading to a purple door.
prompt: A detailed fantasy scene of a female witch with brown hair in a dark green dress and white collar, standing at a wooden alchemy desk inside a stone tower laboratory. She is mixing glowing potions while an open spellbook and various magical items sit on the table. Floating crystal orbs with symbols, a large red lighthouse orb, purple moon orb, and blue crescent moon orb rest on pedestals in the foreground. Shelves filled with colorful potion bottles line the walls, arcane paintings hang on the stone walls, a glowing lantern hangs from the ceiling, and glowing purple and red footprints lead to a purple wooden door.
